summary.text: Deni Taveras is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 47B and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Prince George's County Council member, she serves on the Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Deni Taveras was born in New York City and graduated from Washington Irving High School.

She earned a B.A. in chemistry from Barnard College in 1995, an M.S. from the University of Utah in 1998, and a master of public administration in urban and regional planning from Princeton University in 2003.

Taveras worked as an environmental scientist at the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and in public affairs and infrastructure analysis roles connected to the Federal Emergency Management Agency, according to her legislative biography.
She was a legislative aide to Maryland State Senator Victor Ramirez and served on the Prince George's County Council from 2014 to 2022.
Taveras assumed office in the House of Delegates on January 11, 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly website lists her as a member of the Health Committee.
